hook: One medication entry isn't your health history.
caption:
One dose, logged once, is just a data point. Scheduled, it becomes a running record: the reminder shows up on time, taken or skipped gets logged, every dose lands in your day's history, and the week and month views place it in context. Not a to-do list, a history. #HealthGraph #Medication #HealthHistory #DailyLog #Patterns #HealthData #SelfTracking #Wellness #HealthApp #PersonalRecords
Discover HealthGraph.

lines.text: One medication entry isn't your health history.
lines.beat: home-dashboard: the real Medication card, Add one to star, sits alone with lots of empty space, single-entry feel

lines.text: One dose, logged once, says very little by itself.
lines.beat: Slow push-in on the medication card; one logged dose, the rest of the screen quiet

lines.text: Scheduled, it repeats on the same days.
lines.beat: Same medication card gains a scheduled marker, motif: a quiet recurring calendar dot, no new invented values

lines.text: The reminder shows up exactly when it's due.
lines.beat: The medication card pulses with the restrained red voice-pulse motif at the due moment

lines.text: Taken or skipped, either way gets logged.
lines.beat: The medication card toggles between the taken state and the not taken state, both recorded

lines.text: Each dose becomes an event in your day.
lines.beat: The recorded dose slides into the daily-log Recent history row, joining the pattern of 3 events

lines.text: Then the week and month views place it in context.
lines.beat: home-dashboard: Your patterns, the Week and Month tabs switch, real pattern chart Sleep duration 420min steady as the context chart

lines.text: Not a to-do list. A running record.
lines.beat: Side by side: the medication card and the patterns charts, one entry shown inside its surroundings

lines.text: That's how one entry becomes a history.
lines.beat: Pull back to the full home dashboard: card and patterns together, the single dose now in context
End card: CTA over the dimmed home dashboard, voice FAB idle at the bottom
